title: Newton's Cradle – Classic Kinetic Desk Toy & Executive Gadget
body:
⚖️ Newton's Cradle – Classic Kinetic Desk Toy & Executive Gadget

Discover the fascinating science of motion with the iconic Newton's Cradle! This classic kinetic desk toy combines hypnotic swinging movement with a brilliant demonstration of physics, making it a must-have gadget for science enthusiasts, office desks and curious minds.

Named after the famous scientist Sir Isaac Newton, this intriguing executive desk toy demonstrates the principles of conservation of momentum and energy through a series of suspended swinging balls.

Simply pull back one of the balls and release it. Watch as it strikes the others, transferring momentum through the row and causing the ball at the opposite end to swing out. The mesmerising back-and-forth movement makes this Newton's Cradle desk gadget both entertaining and educational.

✨ Why You'll Love Newton's Cradle

  • ⚖️ Classic kinetic desk toy – an iconic executive gadget with hypnotic swinging movement.
  • 🔬 Demonstrates physics principles – explore momentum and energy transfer through motion.
  • 🌀 Mesmerising swinging action – watch the balls move rhythmically back and forth.
  • 🖥️ Brilliant office desk accessory – an interesting addition to a workspace or study.
  • 🧠 Science-inspired entertainment – a fascinating visual demonstration of mechanical motion.
  • 🎁 Unusual gift idea – perfect for gadget lovers, science fans and office workers.
  • ⚙️ Mechanical operation – works through the movement and collision of the suspended balls.
  • 💡 Conversation starter – an instantly recognisable desk gadget that attracts attention.

🔬 Discover the Science Behind Newton's Cradle

Newton's Cradle is one of the most recognisable demonstrations of classical mechanics.

Each ball is suspended from the frame by strings of equal length. When you pull back and release a ball, it swings forward and collides with the others.

The impact transfers momentum and energy through the stationary balls, causing the ball at the opposite end to swing outward. As it swings back, the process repeats, creating the cradle's famous rhythmic motion.

The movement gradually slows because some energy is lost through friction, air resistance and sound, making this a fascinating real-world demonstration of physics.

🖥️ A Classic Executive Desk Gadget

Looking for an interesting addition to your office or home workspace? This Newton's Cradle executive toy is a brilliant choice.

Its simple yet captivating mechanical movement creates an entertaining visual display, making it a popular style of desk accessory for offices, studies and workspaces.

Margaritaville Caribbean Fruit Punch has a bold, sweet fruit flavour with a tropical-style finish.

Empty one sachet into a bottle or glass of cold water.

title: Ghost Energy Original Bubblicious 473ml
body:
GHOST Energy Original Bubblicious 473ml 🍬⚡🇺🇸

The unmistakable flavour of classic bubble gum transformed into a crisp, sugar-free American energy drink.

GHOST Energy Original Bubblicious is an official collaboration between GHOST and Bubblicious, the iconic bubble gum brand. This limited-edition flavour is designed to recreate the sweet, fruity taste of original Bubblicious gum while delivering the carbonation and functional energy blend associated with GHOST.

Each 473ml can contains 200mg of natural caffeine and no sugar, giving you a strong energy boost without the heavy sweetness of a full-sugar drink. Alongside caffeine, the GHOST Energy formula includes ingredients such as taurine, Carnipure® L-carnitine L-tartrate, Alpha-GPC, NeuroFactor® coffee fruit extract and AstraGin®.

The flavour is candy-sweet and nostalgic, with a smooth bubble-gum character and a crisp carbonated finish. It is a particularly interesting choice for fans of unusual American energy drinks, retro confectionery collaborations and collectible GHOST releases.

Why You’ll Love It

🍬 Classic original bubble-gum flavour
⚡ 200mg of natural caffeine per can
🚫 Zero sugar

🧠 Includes GHOST’s focus-supporting energy blend
🇺🇸 Authentic 473ml American import

Flavour and Drinking Experience

Original Bubblicious has a sweet, fruity candy flavour inspired by traditional bubble gum. It is noticeably different from fruit-led GHOST varieties such as Sour Patch Kids, Warheads or Swedish Fish, focusing instead on a smooth and nostalgic confectionery taste.

The carbonation keeps the drink refreshing and prevents the bubble-gum flavour from feeling overly heavy. Serve it thoroughly chilled for the cleanest flavour and crispest finish.

Why It’s Different

GHOST is known for creating officially licensed energy drinks based on recognisable sweets and soft drinks. This release captures the flavour of original Bubblicious bubble gum, rather than adding strawberry, watermelon or another distinct fruit profile.

It also provides the familiar GHOST Energy formula in a zero-sugar drink. Each 473ml can contains 200mg of caffeine, approximately 42mg per 100ml.

FAQs

What does GHOST Original Bubblicious taste like?
It has a sweet, fruity bubble-gum flavour inspired by the original Bubblicious chewing gum.

Is it the same as Bubblicious Strawberry Splash?
No. Original Bubblicious focuses on classic bubble-gum flavour, while Strawberry Splash has a more distinct strawberry-led taste.

Is it sugar free?
Yes, GHOST Energy Original Bubblicious contains zero sugar.

How much caffeine does it contain?
Each 473ml can contains 200mg of caffeine.

Is it carbonated?
Yes, it is a carbonated energy drink.

Is this an American import?
Yes, this 473ml can is imported from the USA.

High caffeine content. Not recommended for children or pregnant or breastfeeding women (approximately 42mg/100ml). Consume responsibly.

title: Royal Family Mochi Chocolate 120g
body:
Experience the delicious and creamy taste of Royal Family Mochi Creamy Coconut 120g! This mouthwatering treat is a must-have for anyone who loves rich and exotic flavors. Try it today and indulge in a truly delectable experience!

What is Mochi?

A deliciously sticky rice cake, Mochi has been a part of the culture and tradition of Japan since the year 794 during the Japanese Heian period, and has been used for several ceremonies and modern functions. The most common one, and perhaps the one most strongly linked with its identity, is the use of Mochi in the New Year ceremonies of Japan. It is a part of the Kagami Mochi, a decoration that is broken and eaten symbolic of opening a mirror, Zōni, a traditional soup made with taro, carrots, and honeyworts, and Kinako Mochi, created as an emblem of good luck.

Enjoy these Authentic Mochi today!

Pokémon Curry Flavour Rice Mix 50g is a Japanese food product that is inspired by the popular Pokémon franchise. The product is a seasoning mix that is designed to be added to cooked rice to give it a delicious curry flavor.

The seasoning mix contains a blend of spices and other ingredients that are commonly used in Japanese curry dishes, such as cumin, turmeric, and coriander. The combination of flavors creates a spicy and aromatic taste that is perfect for enhancing the flavor of plain rice.

The packaging features cute and colorful Pokémon characters, making it a fun and playful addition to your pantry. Each packet contains 50g of seasoning mix, which is enough to flavor several servings of rice.

Pokémon Curry Flavour Rice Mix 50g is a great option for those who want to add some spice and flavor to their rice but don't have the time or ingredients to make a more elaborate curry dish. It's also a convenient and easy-to-use product that is perfect for those who are short on time but still want a tasty and satisfying meal. And, of course, it's a must-try for fans of the Pokémon franchise who want to experience the fun and delicious side of Japanese cuisine.

title: Herr's Jalapeno Crunchy Cheese Stix 255.2g
body:
Herr’s Jalapeño Crunchy Cheese Stix 255.2g 🌶️🧀🇺🇸

Turn up the crunch with Herr’s Jalapeño Crunchy Cheese Stix, a large American sharing bag packed with bold cheese seasoning and a warming jalapeño kick.

These crunchy corn snacks combine the savoury flavour of cheese with the distinctive green-pepper taste of jalapeño. The heat is noticeable without completely overpowering the cheesy base, making them a good choice for customers who enjoy spicy snacks but do not necessarily want an extreme chilli challenge.

Unlike soft cheese puffs, these stix have a firmer and denser texture. Each piece delivers a crisp bite followed by salty cheese flavour, tangy seasoning and a lingering chilli warmth. The substantial 255.2g bag is well suited to sharing, parties, movie nights or stocking up for anyone who regularly reaches for American savoury snacks.

Imported from the USA, Herr’s Jalapeño Crunchy Cheese Stix offer the louder seasoning and robust crunch commonly associated with American corn snacks. They are particularly suited to fans of jalapeño crisps, cheese curls and spicy imported snacks.

Why You’ll Love Them

🌶️ Warming jalapeño flavour
🧀 Bold and savoury cheese seasoning
🌽 Firm, crunchy corn snack texture
🇺🇸 Authentic American import
📦 Large 255.2g sharing bag
🎬 Great for parties and movie nights

Flavour and Texture

The first flavour is salty, creamy cheese, followed by the tangy and slightly grassy character of jalapeño pepper. A mild-to-medium chilli warmth develops as you eat, leaving a spicy finish without masking the cheese flavour.

The texture is dense and crunchy rather than light and airy. This gives the stix a more substantial bite than conventional cheese puffs and helps them hold plenty of seasoning.

Why They’re Different

Herr’s is known for producing strongly seasoned American crisps and corn snacks. These cheese stix combine three popular snack characteristics in one bag:

  • A firm and satisfying crunch
  • Rich cheese seasoning
  • A warming jalapeño finish

The larger American pack size also makes them more suitable for sharing than a standard individual bag.

Here's another jalapeno favourite from Herr's; Herr's Jalapeno Cheese Curls are the puffy, baked cheesy snack that everyone loves.

title: Cadbury's Caramilk (Canada) 50g
body:
Cadbury Caramilk Chocolate Bar Canada 50g 🍫🍯🇨🇦

Discover one of Canada’s best-known chocolate bars with Cadbury Caramilk 50g, an individually portioned milk chocolate bar filled with a smooth, flowing caramel centre.

This Canadian Caramilk should not be confused with caramelised white chocolate products sold under a similar name in other countries. The Canadian version combines Cadbury milk chocolate with pockets of soft, sweet caramel, creating a contrast between the firm chocolate shell and the sticky centre inside.

Each segmented piece has a creamy cocoa flavour followed by a rich caramel sweetness. The milk chocolate melts smoothly, while the filling adds a soft, slightly chewy texture that makes the bar feel more indulgent than a standard solid chocolate block.

Imported from Canada, this 50g bar is a convenient choice for anyone exploring international Cadbury products, building a Canadian snack box or looking for a chocolate-and-caramel combination that is difficult to find in ordinary UK shops.

Why You’ll Love It

🍫 Creamy Cadbury milk chocolate
🍯 Filled with smooth caramel centres
🇨🇦 Authentic Canadian edition
🥛 Rich, sweet and creamy flavour
🎁 Ideal for imported snack boxes
📏 Convenient 50g individual bar

Flavour and Texture

Cadbury Caramilk begins with a familiar sweet milk chocolate flavour. Bite through the chocolate shell and you reach a soft caramel filling with a rich, syrupy consistency.

The chocolate provides a firm initial snap before melting in the mouth, while the caramel gives each piece a smoother, stickier finish. It is sweeter and more texturally varied than a plain milk chocolate bar, making it well suited to fans of caramel-filled chocolates.

Why It’s Different

Canadian Cadbury Caramilk is made as a filled milk chocolate bar. Each section contains caramel sealed inside a chocolate shell, rather than caramel flavour being blended through the chocolate itself.

This gives the bar two distinct layers of flavour and texture:

  • Creamy milk chocolate on the outside
  • Sweet, flowing caramel in the centre

Its Canadian recipe and packaging also make it an appealing choice for collectors and customers interested in regional Cadbury releases.

Coffee mate Crème Brûlée Coffee Creamer 946ml ☕🍮🇺🇸

Enjoy the luxurious taste of a classic French dessert in every cup with Coffee mate Crème Brûlée Coffee Creamer 946ml.

Inspired by the famous caramelised custard dessert, this rich American coffee creamer combines creamy vanilla custard notes with buttery caramel flavour, creating a smooth, indulgent coffee experience. It transforms ordinary coffee into a café-style treat without needing separate cream, flavoured syrups or sugar.

The Crème Brûlée flavour offers a delicious balance of sweet vanilla, silky cream and toasted caramel, making it a perfect companion for hot coffee, iced coffee and cold brew. Whether you're starting your morning or enjoying an afternoon pick-me-up, every splash adds dessert-inspired richness to your favourite brew.

Supplied in a generous 946ml bottle, it's ideal for home coffee bars, offices and anyone who enjoys premium flavoured coffee every day.

Why You'll Love It

🍮 Inspired by classic crème brûlée dessert

☕ Creates smooth café-style coffee at home

✨ Rich vanilla custard and caramel flavour

🧊 Perfect for hot or iced coffee

🇺🇸 Authentic American Coffee mate import

📦 Large 946ml bottle

Flavour and Texture

Coffee mate Crème Brûlée delivers rich vanilla custard flavour layered with buttery caramel and subtle toasted sugar notes.

Its silky liquid consistency blends effortlessly into coffee, creating a smooth, creamy finish while softening bitterness and adding a luxurious sweetness reminiscent of freshly caramelised crème brûlée.

Why It's Different

Unlike standard vanilla creamers, Crème Brûlée combines creamy custard flavour with caramelised sugar notes for a richer, dessert-inspired profile.

It's an easy way to recreate premium coffee shop drinks at home without needing flavoured syrups or whipped cream.

Perfect for:

  • Hot filter coffee
  • Espresso-based drinks
  • Iced coffee
  • Cold brew
  • Homemade lattes
  • Hot chocolate

How to Use

Shake well before use.

Simply pour your preferred amount into hot or cold coffee and stir well. Adjust the quantity to achieve your desired level of sweetness and creaminess.

Storage Information

Store and refrigerate according to the instructions printed on the bottle.

After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within the manufacturer's recommended period.

FAQs

What does Coffee mate Crème Brûlée taste like?

It combines creamy vanilla custard with rich caramel and lightly toasted sugar notes, inspired by the classic French dessert.

Is it suitable for iced coffee?

Yes. It mixes easily into iced coffee, cold brew and blended coffee drinks.

Do I need to add sugar?

Many people find the creamer sweet enough on its own, although you can sweeten further to suit your personal preference.

Is this a liquid or powdered creamer?

This is a ready-to-pour liquid coffee creamer.

How much does the bottle contain?

Each bottle contains 946ml.

Where is it from?

This Coffee mate flavour is imported from the USA.

Crunchy, fry-shaped corn and potato snacks coated in a bold, savoury cheddar cheese seasoning.

Andy Capp’s Cheddar Fries bring the look of classic French fries into a light, crispy American snack. Rather than being made like ordinary potato crisps, these crunchy sticks combine cornmeal and dried potato to create an airy texture with a satisfying bite.

Each piece is covered in a rich cheddar seasoning featuring cheese powder, onion, herbs and spices. The flavour is salty, tangy and distinctly cheesy, with additional depth from cheddar and blue cheese. Dried chives and parsley add a subtle herby finish that helps distinguish them from standard cheese-flavoured crisps.

The fry-shaped pieces make them easy to share, pour into a snack bowl or enjoy straight from the bag. Imported from the USA, this 85g pack is a good choice for fans of American snacks, strong cheese flavours and crunchy alternatives to conventional potato crisps.

Flavour and Texture

Andy Capp’s Cheddar Fries have a crisp, airy crunch rather than the thin snap of a standard potato crisp. The seasoning is rich and savoury, combining cheddar with a slightly sharper blue cheese note.

Onion powder, yeast extract, herbs and spices build a fuller flavour, while the fry shape gives each piece plenty of surface area for the cheese coating. They are especially suited to customers who enjoy snacks such as cheese puffs, corn snacks and heavily seasoned American crisps.

title: Royal Family Mochi Maple Pancake 120g
body:
Experience the delicious and creamy taste of Royal Family Mochi Creamy Coconut 120g! This mouthwatering treat is a must-have for anyone who loves rich and exotic flavors. Try it today and indulge in a truly delectable experience!

What is Mochi?

A deliciously sticky rice cake, Mochi has been a part of the culture and tradition of Japan since the year 794 during the Japanese Heian period, and has been used for several ceremonies and modern functions. The most common one, and perhaps the one most strongly linked with its identity, is the use of Mochi in the New Year ceremonies of Japan. It is a part of the Kagami Mochi, a decoration that is broken and eaten symbolic of opening a mirror, Zōni, a traditional soup made with taro, carrots, and honeyworts, and Kinako Mochi, created as an emblem of good luck.

Enjoy these Authentic Mochi today!

🍊 Quench your thirst with the vibrant citrus burst of Hatakosen Orange Ramune Soda (Japan) 200ml. This traditional Japanese fizzy drink comes in the iconic glass marble-sealed bottle and bursts with juicy orange flavour – fruity, fragrant, and incredibly refreshing.

Whether you're a fan of Japanese snacks and drinks or love trying rare sodas from around the world, this one’s a must-try. It's not just a drink – it’s an experience!

Why not check out our range of drinks and sodas from Japan.

When it comes to Japanese soda drinks, Ramune Soda is one of the most popular. It's also called the ‘marble drink’ because of the glass marble used as a cap to seal Ramune Soda and keep it fizzy. There's a special way to open them too, if you want to find out more read our blog What is Ramune Soda?, you'll be amazed!

Ingredients: Sugar, Glucose-Fructose Syrup, Carbon Dioxide, Acidity Regulator (Citric Acid (E330)), Flavourings, Colours (Tartrazine (E102), Allura Red (E129)).

Allergens marked in BOLD.

Warning: Tartrazine (E102) and Allura Red (E129) may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children.

title: Jelly Belly Fruit Mix Bag 70g
body:
If you love Jelly Belly Fruity flavours, then this Grab 'n Go bag will be right up your street. It's all of Jelly Belly's most popular fruit flavours packed into one 70g bag and it's great for sharing with friends!

Flavours can include: Blueberry, Coconut, Grape, Green Apple, Juicy Pear, Lemon, Lemon Lime, Peach, Pink Grapefruit, Pomegranate, Raspberry, Red Apple, Tangerine, Top Banana, Very Cherry, Watermelon.
